units.source_text: 在当时的拍卖场上，将白料子买下来的，是那个日本桥区长谷川町三十二号的胜田佐一郎先生……

en.t: At the auction house then, the man who bought the white fabric was Mr. Saichiro Katsuta of 32 Hasegawa-cho, Nihonbashi Ward...

units.source_text: 却说这位胜田先生虽然用做梦般的便宜价钱买了下来，

en.t: Now, although this Mr. Katsuta had bought it at a dreamlike bargain price,

units.source_text: 可是转念又想，它是仓库受损坏最严重的锦纱，

en.t: on second thought, it was the silk gauze most badly damaged in the warehouse,

units.source_text: 如何把它处理掉是个问题。

en.t: and how to dispose of it became a problem.

units.source_text: 首先他召集主要店员来商量。

en.t: First, he called together the chief clerks to discuss it.

units.source_text: 全体成员绞尽脑汁，也想不出个像样的好办法来。

en.t: Everyone racked their brains, but no one could come up with a decent good plan.

units.source_text: 总之，但凡有斑点的地方依次迅速地剪下来扔掉。

en.t: In any case, wherever there were spots, they quickly cut those parts away one by one and threw them out.

units.source_text: 并且决定把剩下的部分，用各种办法推销出去。

en.t: They also decided to sell off the remaining parts by every possible method.

units.source_text: 比如不到一尺的就染成可爱的红色和绿色，做木偶服装；

en.t: For example, pieces shorter than one shaku were dyed charming reds and greens and made into puppet costumes;

units.source_text: 稍长的就做包袱皮或小方绸巾……

en.t: slightly longer pieces were made into wrapping cloths or small square silk kerchiefs...

units.source_text: 一丈一尺以上的，就完全按其尺寸剪齐，做男人或小孩用的腰带。

en.t: Pieces of one jo and one shaku or more were cut neatly to their exact dimensions and made into sashes for men or children.

units.source_text: 然而，就像刚才所说的那样，质地是供出口用的特优产品。

en.t: However, as just mentioned, the material itself was a top-grade product intended for export.

units.source_text: 难得的质地一概都染了，也怪糟蹋东西的。

en.t: To dye all of that fine material indiscriminately would have seemed a terrible waste.
When it came to dyeing, Kyoto was considered the most authentic place.

units.source_text: 因此就送往京都三条的池上加工店，而且是手扎染的。

en.t: So it was sent to the Ikegami processing shop on Sanjo in Kyoto, and it was tie-dyed by hand.

units.source_text: 就像这个，您一看就明白，它不是那种用机械扎染的浅扎染法。

en.t: As with this piece, you can tell at a glance that it is not the shallow tie-dyeing done by machine.

units.source_text: 怎么样，这种深扎染法看起来很舒心吧……

en.t: What do you think? This deep tie-dyeing method looks quite pleasing, does it not...

units.source_text: 如果做男腰带，可以说是最好不过的上乘扎染法了。

en.t: For making men's sashes, it could be called the finest possible kind of superior tie-dyeing.
